verification.notes: Verified as an attribution claim. Euronews directly quotes a French Ministry of Armed Forces spokesperson saying Robinson was never a Foreign Legion member and that, absent service in a U.S. military unit, he could not have trained with the Legion. This verifies the Ministry quotation; it does not independently validate every premise of the spokesperson’s conditional reasoning.

appearances.snippet: The Ministry of the Armed Forces confirms that a training exercise by the 2nd Foreign Infantry Regiment, a unit of the French Foreign Legion, did indeed take place in California from August 2nd to the 25th, as reported by Candace Owens.

verification.notes: French Army reporting states that the 2nd Foreign Infantry Regiment trained at Twentynine Palms from August 2 through 25, 2025. Official U.S. military reporting independently confirms the 2e REI’s 4th Company arrived August 4, trained with U.S. Marines, and completed the exercise by August 25. The Ministry-attributed statement is supported.

verification.notes: Verified as an attribution claim. Euronews quotes the French Ministry spokesperson denying Foreign Legion training at the misspelled “Camp Riley” between August 25 and September 10, 2025 and noting that California training ended August 25. This does not answer whether any Legion personnel trained at the real Camp Ripley; the statement and evidence are limited to what the Ministry actually denied.
